biotools.summary: The Coronavirus Immunotherapy Consortium (CoVIC) created CoVIC-DB, a database that provides a publicly accessible dataset of SARS-CoV-2 antibody features, including in vivo protection and epitope binning, to guide antibody therapeutic selection and immunogen design.
